use default
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.Random

use Place = (x: int, y: int, z: int)

class ROOM(items: LIST[string]) is
    exits: SET[string] public
    name: string? public

    init(..) is
        exits = SET[string]()
    si
si

let random = Random(28)

let steps = MAP[string, Place]()
steps["north"] = (0, 1, 0)
steps["south"] = (0, -1, 0)
steps["east"] = (1, 0, 0)
steps["west"] = (-1, 0, 0)
steps["up"] = (0, 0, 1)
steps["down"] = (0, 0, -1)

let opposite = MAP[string, string]()
opposite["north"] = "south"
opposite["south"] = "north"
opposite["east"] = "west"
opposite["west"] = "east"
opposite["up"] = "down"
opposite["down"] = "up"

let aliases = MAP[string, string]()

for (short, long) in [
    ("n", "north"), ("s", "south"), ("e", "east"), ("w", "west"),
    ("u", "up"), ("d", "down"), ("i", "inventory"), ("inv", "inventory"),
    ("a", "attack")
] do
    aliases[short] = long
od

let goal = (x = 1, y = 1, z = 5)
let rooms = MAP[Place, ROOM]()

let start = ROOM(LIST[string](["sledge"]))
start.name = "the start"
rooms[(x = 0, y = 0, z = 0)] = start

let prize = ROOM(LIST[string](["gold", "gold", "gold"]))
prize.name = "the prize room"
rooms[goal] = prize

let here mut = (x = 0, y = 0, z = 0)
let carrying = LIST[string]()
let equipped: string? mut = null

room() -> ROOM => rooms[here]

describe() is
    let current = room()
    let (x, y, z) = here
    let called = if let name = current.name then " ({name})" else "" fi

    write_line("you are at {x},{y},{z}{called}")

    if current.items.count > 0 then
        write_line("here: {current.items |> join(", ")}")
    fi

    let exits = current.exits |> collect_list()
    exits.sort()
    let listed = if exits.count == 0 then "none" else exits |> join(", ") fi
    write_line("exits: {listed}")
si

neighbour(direction: string) -> Place =>
    let step = steps[direction] in
    (x = here.x + step.x, y = here.y + step.y, z = here.z + step.z)

move(direction: string) is
    if !room().exits.contains(direction) then
        write_line("there is no way {direction}")
    elif direction =~ "up" /\ !room().items.contains("ladder") then
        write_line("you need a ladder in this room to climb up")
    else
        here = neighbour(direction)
        describe()

        if here =~ goal then
            write_line("you have found the prize room!")
        fi
    fi
si

attack(direction: string) is
    if !(equipped =~ "sledge") then
        write_line("you need to equip a sledge to break through")
        return
    fi

    let target = neighbour(direction)

    if !rooms.contains_key(target) then
        let item = ["sledge", "ladder", "gold"][random.next(3)]
        rooms[target] = ROOM(LIST[string]([item]))
    fi

    room().exits.add(direction)
    rooms[target].exits.add(opposite[direction])

    write_line("you break a hole in the {direction} wall")
si

move_items(from: LIST[string], to: LIST[string], what: string) -> bool is
    let chosen =
        if what =~ "all" then from |> collect_list()
        elif from.contains(what) then LIST[string]([what])
        else LIST[string]()
        fi

    for item in chosen do
        from.remove(item)
        to.add(item)
    od

    chosen.count > 0
si

describe()

while let line = read_line() do
    write_line("> {line}")

    let words =
        line.to_lower()
            .split([' '], System.StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES)

    if words.count == 0 then
        continue
    fi

    let command =
        if aliases.contains_key(words[0]) then aliases[words[0]]
        else words[0]
        fi

    let argument = if words.count > 1 then words[1] else "" fi

    if steps.contains_key(command) then
        move(command)
    elif command =~ "attack" /\ steps.contains_key(argument) then
        attack(argument)
    elif command =~ "take" then
        if move_items(room().items, carrying, argument) then
            write_line("taken")
        else
            write_line("there is no {argument} here")
        fi
    elif command =~ "drop" then
        if move_items(carrying, room().items, argument) then
            write_line("dropped")
        else
            write_line("you have no {argument}")
        fi

        if !carrying.contains(equipped ?? "") then
            equipped = null
        fi
    elif command =~ "inventory" then
        let held =
            if carrying.count == 0 then "nothing"
            else carrying |> join(", ")
            fi

        write_line("you are carrying {held}")

        if let item = equipped then
            write_line("you have the {item} equipped")
        fi
    elif command =~ "equip" then
        if carrying.contains(argument) then
            equipped = argument
            write_line("you equip the {argument}")
        else
            write_line("you have no {argument}")
        fi
    elif command =~ "name" /\ words.count > 1 then
        room().name = line.trim().substring(words[0].length).trim()
        write_line("this room is now called {room().name}")
    elif command =~ "alias" /\ words.count == 3 then
        aliases[words[2]] =
            if aliases.contains_key(argument) then aliases[argument]
            else argument
            fi

        write_line("{words[2]} now means {aliases[words[2]]}")
    elif command =~ "look" then
        describe()
    else
        write_line("commands: north, south, east, west, up, down,")
        write_line("attack <direction>, take <item|all>, drop <item|all>,")
        write_line("equip <item>, inventory, name <name>,")
        write_line("alias <command> <new name>, look")
    fi
od
